propositions: MCP autodeploy target must implement blue-green deployment (build immutable image, start new container on free port, health-check, atomic nginx upstream flip, graceful retire old) without killing in-flight certified operations
Memory pre-check must abort deployment if MemAvailable < MCP_MEM_MIN_MB before starting second container; unreadable memory fails open
Graceful retire must issue docker stop --time 1260 (SIGTERM self-drain) in background, never docker rm -f, and never wait on drain completion before deploy exits
Port exhaustion guard: if both A/B ports bound by in-flight containers, deploy emits AUTODEPLOY_MCP_RETIRE_CAP without forcing third container
Health-check or nginx reload failure must restore old upstream, leave old container unchanged, emit AUTODEPLOY_ERROR, and not advance deployed-sha

Change detection triggers only mcp target on MCP_PATHS changes; shared paths (src/rebar, docker-compose.yml) trigger both mcp and review-bot independently; existing compose-mcp-1 on port 8091 is managed and retired gracefully like any other
